items.title: Minor "Ram" Hall Interview, 1958-09-02
items.q: So he was up there working with them at the Deluxe Cafe at 35th and State, a fellow by the name of Shaw.

ctx.x: Yeah, they went up there, and they had a band at the Deluxe Cafe. Lawrence Dewey with them. That's right, I think Lawrence Dewey had a band at that time, yeah. So he was up there working with them at the Deluxe Cafe at 35th and State, a fellow by the name of Shaw. And so about later on my oldest brother went up to Chicago, but he wasn't a musician. So that left my mother, my father, and myself still in New Orleans. So that's when he sent for the three of us. When I first went up to Chicago, I didn't have any job…
And you both went to Chicago the same trip, the same time?
